subject: Signed bundle transfer & offline update checklist
content:
From: Jordan Lee <ops@acme-corp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signed bundle transfer & offline update checklist

Hi Naomi,

We have a maintenance window the weekend of Aug 7 and want to confirm the offline transfer process for the private (VPC) deployment. Specifically:

- How should we receive the signed bundle (S3 transfer or physical media)?
- What verification steps do your runtime/service teams expect on our side?
- Are there key-rotation windows tied to the install?

We need a one-page checklist for the ops team and a signed artifact we can validate ahead of the window. Can you confirm timeline and what files you will provide?

Thanks,
Jordan
Ops Lead, Acme Corp
[Attachment: requirements_outline.pdf (application/pdf)]

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signed bundle transfer & offline update checklist

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Per our offline deployment playbook, here is what we will provide and the verification flow:

1) Deliverables (we will attach):
   - bundle_manifest.yaml (checksums, component versions, signer metadata)
   - signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig (OpenPGP detached signature over the tarball)
   - transfer_checklist.pdf (one-page ops checklist for install)

2) Transfer options:
   - Secure S3 presigned URL (recommended for most customers) with limited TTL + B2/remote mirror as fallback, OR
   - Physical encrypted USB with tamper-evident seal (for air-gapped sites) — shipped via vetted carrier.

3) Verification steps (customer-side):
   - Validate manifest checksums against tarball.
   - Verify detached signature using our public key (we will provide fingerprint).
   - Ensure node-level package manager checksums match the manifest before install.

4) Key rotation and windows:
   - We recommend rotating the serving API key the day after install in case of operator access during install.
   - Signing keys: our signing key will remain the same for the bundle; if a rotation is required, we will coordinate a signed transitional bundle and a DSAR note.

5) Timeline:
   - We can produce the signed bundle and manifest within 48 business hours after final build verification (target: Tues, Aug 3).
   - Transfer link (or shipment) details will be sent 24 hours before the maintenance window.

Attached is the initial manifest and the ops checklist. Marcus and Evelyn are looped for the cryptographic and compliance signoff.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bundle_manifest.yaml (text/yaml)]
[Attachment: transfer_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signed bundle transfer & offline update checklist

Jordan / Naomi — a few technical clarifications from runtime: 

- Signature format: we will use an OpenPGP detached signature (sha256) plus an armored sig file. Verification example: gpg --verify signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig signed_bundle.tar.gz
- Key fingerprint (prod signing key): 3A2B 9C11 4F5E 7D22 91AA  6B8E 5C3D B4E7 9F02 1C6A
- Bundle contents summary (from manifest): model.tar (quantized), runtime_patch.tar, config_overrides.yaml, rsa_keys.tar (encrypted placeholder)
- Post-install smoke: run /usr/local/bin/redwood-health --manifest /opt/redwood/manifest.yaml (should report up/down for each component)

On key rotation: if Acme wants us to rotate the runtime encryption keys during the window we will prepare a special rotation bundle that includes the new pubkeys and migration instructions; that requires explicit written approval 48 hours prior.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Staff Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig (application/pgp-signature, 8 KB)]

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <ops@acme-corp.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signed bundle transfer & offline update checklist

Jordan — compliance side confirmed the checklist and signature scheme. A couple of final notes:

- Acceptable transfer for Acme: S3 presigned URL is acceptable for our audit, provided we deliver the manifest and signature and you verify the fingerprint above.
- We will attach a signed acceptance memo (PDF) after you confirm the presigned link retrieval during the window.
- Please confirm whether you need a physical shipment label; if so we will open a shipment ticket and provide chain-of-custody docs.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
  1) Acme confirms preferred transfer method by EOD Mon, Aug 2.
  2) Redwood produces final signed bundle and manifest by Tue, Aug 3.
  3) Acme validates signature + checksums in a staging VM prior to Aug 7 window.
  4) Post-install, Acme sends signed acceptance to compliance@redwood.ai (or reply-all) and we will close the change.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed_acceptance_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

---
Notes: Attachments referenced above will be uploaded to our secure drive link and a DocuSign envelope will be prepared for the acceptance memo. If Acme needs an HSM-backed signing flow for the bundle, flag that — it's a separate engagement.
